name: Teikyuu Yuugi - Stories
source:
There are three stories:
1. Tezuka and Fuji are looking for a mysterious witch Yukimura in an isolated Western-style house
2. What is the sad dream that protagonist sees every night? The search for the destiny prince begins.
3. A genius gets tricked and struggles against the remnants of a married couple. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
共有三个故事：
1. 手冢和不二在偏僻的西式房屋中寻找神秘的魔女幸村2. 主角每晚都会做的悲伤的梦是什么？寻找命运王子的旅程开始了。
3、天才被骗，与夫妻余孽作斗争。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
